_comment: Single source of truth for external art. Key = the art key used by the game's art maps (ART_IMG, IMG, FAC_IMG, ...) or declared by a layer (hq_* from 90-hq-stages.js). Value = filename, resolved against art/ first and the repo root second. Two keys may point at the same file when different bundles name the same subject differently — see the aliases section. Assets are registered as soon as the file lands in art/; visual QA is done by the project owner outside this repo, so a known cosmetic defect is not a blocker — it is recorded in accepted_with_defects and shipped. 85-art-override.js reads this file at boot and reports coverage to the console.
_aliases_comment: house_* and car_* are the legacy IMG bundle's names for subjects that ART_IMG calls starter, family, mansion, sedan, sports and suv. Both keys are listed so a screen reading either map gets the new art. IMG's remaining keys — jet, vac_beach, vac_cabin, vac_paris — have no external asset yet.
_coverage_comment: Remaining keys with no external asset: sailboat (watercraft), ultralight (aircraft), jet (vehicle ladder and legacy IMG), and the collectibles art, watch, vault and racing. vac_beach, vac_cabin and vac_paris are also still unfilled.

accepted_with_defects._comment: Live in assets by explicit decision, but they violate their prompt's strict exclusions. Regenerate these first when image credits allow.
accepted_with_defects.brownstone: Legible street signage, pedestrians and a taxi. Text and people are both excluded.
accepted_with_defects.ski: Translucent inset border roughly 3% in from each edge. Borders are excluded.
accepted_with_defects.studio: Isometric dollhouse cutaway on a flat dark background. Flat backgrounds are excluded.
accepted_with_defects.compound: Helipad marked with the letter H. Lettering is excluded.
accepted_with_defects.hq_1: Isometric cutaway office floor on a flat green/blue background. Same failure mode as studio. Shipped because an empty slot on stage 2 of the ladder reads as a broken build.
accepted_with_defects.chauffeur: Strongly resembles a specific luxury marque's grille and bonnet ornament. Real-world marques are excluded. Shipped by explicit decision — no badges or lettering present.
accepted_with_defects.track: Reads as a specific manufacturer's GT race car silhouette. Same class of issue as chauffeur, shipped on the same decision.
accepted_with_defects.pickup: Translucent vertical bands overlaying the left and right edges, same artifact class as ski. Previously held; shipped by explicit decision.
accepted_with_defects.superyacht: Helipad marked with the letter H, plus a helicopter. Lettering is excluded — same class as compound.
accepted_with_defects.classic: Radiator shell and bonnet ornament read as a specific pre-war luxury marque. Same class as chauffeur.
accepted_with_defects.island: Legible 'SPA' lettering on the outbuilding at right. Text is excluded.
accepted_with_defects.airliner: Background skyline includes a recognisable real-world landmark tower silhouette.
accepted_with_defects.heli: Airframe reads as a specific twin-engine executive helicopter model.
accepted_with_defects.lightjet: Airframe reads as a specific single-engine very light jet model.

held._comment: Empty by policy. Assets are no longer withheld for cosmetic defects — register them and record the defect in accepted_with_defects instead.
